PLAY ONLINE

Play with a friend

One person makes a room and shares the six-character code. The other joins it. On separate devices, both players use W A S D, Space, J and Shift on their own keyboard.

Room setup

The Supabase browser configuration lives in the game code. Realtime must be enabled in the Supabase project. Use only the publishable/anon key in this browser game — never a service-role key.

Online play is ready when the Supabase configuration is present in the game code.

Settings

Graphics
Pitch & time

Pitch art and graphics are local to this device. They are never sent to the other player.

Keyboard controls

Hold shoot to charge, then release. Move sideways while shooting to add curve. Without the ball, shoot becomes tackle. With your keeper selected, it becomes dive. Keeper tracking stays assisted until you move.

Click a key to remap it. Test held keys below: missing keys mean your keyboard cannot register that combination. Try different bindings or a second USB keyboard. No browser can remove hardware ghosting.

Keyboard test: hold your match keys together.

SEVEN / Floodlights

A seven-a-side football game for quick matches, either on one keyboard or online with a friend.

3D rendering: Three.js, MIT license.
Gameplay: fixed-step arcade football physics.
Menu artwork: OpenAI image generation. Higgsfield generation was unavailable due to account credits.
Audio: synthesized stadium ambience and match effects.

You can return to the home screen at any time. To close the game, close this browser tab.
